in_sanskrit.name: Ragib
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Joyful, One who Rules
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ragib एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ragib is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, and it means 'Joyful, One who Rules'. This name is associated with the themes of joy, light, and rulership. It is a powerful and evocative name that is often given to babies who are expected to bring happiness and prosperity to their families.
